question: Can factual online credit across lag 0..3 improve chosen outcomes on delayed and switching actuators over an identically updated current-only causal ablation, while detecting the no-causal-effect sham?
null: No stable >=0.05 mean reward gain across 3 model seeds over an equal-update online current-only or action-permuted control; false action causality may persist on sham.

design.lag_credit_model: 5x5 sequential factual regularized discounted least-squares with explicit lag0..3 causal action features. This is a strong prior not autonomous causal discovery.
design.equal_online_budgets: full-lag vs current-only vs permuted-history: all same 5x5 solver/update shapes and 64 factual scored updates; no-adapt updates only 8 warmup events
design.privileged_diagnostic: Reads source sign and lag, NOT a fair trained baseline or reliable upper bound under variable delays.
design.reward_primary: per-policy actual chosen-action consequences; complete 64-step trace and SHA256 receipt

hypotheses.threshold_requirement: each direction in all three model seeds per world family; preserve every failure

design.integrity: exact common factual history; own chosen action then actual observed consequence; sham actual consequences identical across action policies; no unknown labels to models; same source-trained control updates and sampler digest; full final OS qualification
